content: Admission Inquiry Academics / KSS Microbiology Krishna School of Science develops microbiology learners through applied laboratory training, research orientation, and strong industry relevance. 0 Established 0 UG + PG Programs 0 M.Sc. Career Tracks 0 Career Clusters LEADERSHIP NOTE Message From the HOD KSS Dr. Parul Shrivastava Head of Department, Microbiology parulshrivastava.kss@kpgu.ac.in Greetings from the Department of Microbiology at Krishna School of Science, Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University, Vadodara. Since its inception in 2020, the department has focused on quality education and practical training for students from rural and urban backgrounds. Our academic direction is to build skilled microbiology professionals for pharmaceuticals, food, healthcare, agriculture, and research sectors. Faculty expertise, modern laboratories, and project-based learning support this goal. Aligned with NEP-2020, the department aims to create an enriching and supportive ecosystem where students can solve real-world challenges and grow into confident professionals and researchers. ABOUT DEPARTMENT Microbiology Education With Research and Application 01 The Department of Microbiology at Krishna School of Science, Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU), offers B.Sc. in Microbiology under CBCS and has launched M.Sc. Microbiology from 2024. Department facilities include modern laboratories and classroom infrastructure for strong academic and practical learning. 02 The department has competent faculty members with diverse teaching and research experience from national and international institutes. Collaborative MOUs with academia and industry support student training, internships, and placements. 03 Industrial and institutional tours are organized regularly. Students are encouraged to undertake mini research projects and technical report writing, and they participate in national and international workshops, seminars, conferences, and training sessions. 04 VAC and value-based learning initiatives are integrated to nurture responsible citizenship. Activities such as NCC, NSS, social drives, plastic-free campus campaigns, blood donation camps, and field visits support holistic development. VALUES & GOALS Vision & Mission Vision TThe Department of Microbiology endeavors to be perceived for excellence in Teaching – Learning adjunct by accrediting graduating students to strive in and confer to the developing exigency of the society. 01 Procure quality teaching-learning, research and service opportunities leading to holistic development of students through collusive exchange of ideas, unallied thought, and the highest ethical standards. 02 Serve high quality academic experiences through comprehensive & relevant curriculum at UG levels. 03 Foster research aptitude by extending infrastructural support and research guidance. 04 Inculcate the values of multi-disciplinary and inter-disciplinary approach and innovative thinking by promoting learning experiences in the field of chemical sciences and its allied fields. 05 Fruitage knowledgeable graduates for careers in academia, industry and GOs/NGOs. 06 Promote an ethical and professional environment amongst faculties and students of the department. SCOPE OF PROGRAM B.Sc. and M.Sc. Microbiology Pathways 01 After B.Sc. (Microbiology), students can pursue higher studies, jobs, or internships for industry readiness. 02 Government initiatives make microbiology-related entrepreneurship and startup pathways increasingly viable. 03 Graduates can also prepare for civil service and other government-sector examinations. 04 After M.Sc. Microbiology, students can pursue doctoral programs and advanced research projects in India and abroad. M.SC. OPPORTUNITIES Advanced Career Possibilities 01 Research and Development roles in pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and environmental science 02 Healthcare roles in clinical microbiology, diagnostics, and infectious disease domains 03 Pharmaceutical industry roles in drug development, quality control, and regulatory pathways 04 Food microbiology opportunities in food safety, quality, and product development 05 Environmental microbiology roles in microbial ecology, bioremediation, and sustainability 06 Academic careers through Ph.D. pathways in teaching and research 07 Government and regulatory roles in public health, food safety, and environmental oversight 08 Consultancy and compliance advisory opportunities 09 Entrepreneurship pathways including microbiology labs and biotech startups CAREER TRACKS Jobs, Certificate Areas, Further Studies, Civil Services 01 Jobs Pharmaceutical Industry Environmental Agency Food Industry Beverage Industry Chemical Industry Agriculture Department Government and Private Hospitals Laboratories Research Projects 02 Certificate Areas Clinical Labs Health Care Industry Military Hospitals Forensic Labs 03 Further Studies M.Sc.
